display.title: Episode 40: The Return of Yisrolik (Selichos)
display.summary_short: A prince who fell in with bad company returns home in rags, and the king knows him only by his voice: Uncle Yossi's parable for Selichos and Shema Koleinu.
display.summary_long: Recorded the week before Selichos 5742. Uncle Yossi welcomes listeners back from vacation, wishes everyone a kesivah vachasimah tovah and the greatest blessing of all, Moshiach now, and leads a Hakochainik march with homemade drums. Story time: a king raises his only son, Yisrolik, with the finest teachers and sends him to tour the country, warning him to choose good friends. Little by little Yisrolik falls in with dishonest company and becomes an unrecognizable tramp. A nine-year-old yeshiva boy leads the Shema in Studio 604. Yisrolik decides to return, but the guards laugh at him and even the king, seeing him from the balcony, does not recognize him, until Yisrolik cries out and the king knows his son's voice and takes him back. Uncle Yossi explains that this is Selichos: our misdeeds have soiled our appearance, but we come to our Father and King and say Shema Koleinu, hear our voice, which is why the Aron Kodesh is opened for that prayer. He urges children to come to shul for Selichos this Saturday night, and announces Uncle Yossi's eighth story record and tape.
display.lesson: However far we have strayed, Hashem our Father always recognizes the sincere voice of a child who returns to Him.

date.note: 'Rosh Hashanah is just around the corner'; Selichos 'this coming Saturday night' = 11 Sept 1982 (Rosh Hashanah 5743 fell on 18 Sept). Matches the weekly estimate.

sources_cited.note: The Aron Kodesh is opened when Shema Koleinu is said.
